system.description: Duration: 0 to 60 rounds Effect: Delayed blast fireball of 20' radius As the name implies, this is a fireball spell whose blast can be delayed; it behaves like a time bomb. When he casts the spell, the magicuser states the exact number of rounds of delay (from 0 to 60) until the spell detonates. A small rock, very similar in appearance to a valuable gem, then shoots out toward the desired location, and remains at that location until the stated delay elapses. The "gem" may be picked up, carried, and so forth.
